question: Under what condition must concealment be undertaken in the mortal world among the lowest of men?
premises: Concealment is prescribed as a necessary act.
Effort is the means by which concealment is to be applied.
This duty applies specifically in the mortal world among the lowest of men.
inference: Concealment must be carried out with effort in the mortal world among the lowest of men.
plain_english: What is to be concealed must be concealed with effort in the mortal world among the lowest of men.
